mapper.select: INSERT INTO device_event (tenant_id, device_id, device_code, event_type, payload, run_id, source_event_id, process_id, interaction_step) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceCode}, #{eventType}, COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(#{payloadJson}, '') AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), #{runId}, #{sourceEventId}, #{processId}, #{interactionStep}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, device_code, source_event_id) WHERE source_event_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET source_event_id = EXCLUDED.source_event_id RETURNING id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM device_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

INSERT INTO device_event_run_cursor (tenant_id, run_id, base_event_id) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{runId}, COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM device_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, run_id) DO UPDATE SET base_event_id = device_event_run_cursor.base_event_id RETURNING base_event_id
SELECT id FROM device_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
